    have h17 := hf1' x (1 / f x) H'
    rw [div_mul_cancel] at h17
    have h19 := hf' (1 / f x)
    rw [one_div_one_div] at h19

                 _ = 1 + 1 := by rw [add_right_cancel_iff, mul_one_div, div_eq_one]
